title: This AI can read your mind and it's terrifying

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Look at this — AI that can guess your thoughts in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This tech is already being used in consumer apps today.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s an AI called MindReader that decodes brain signals from a headset.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses 32 sensors and machine learning to translate thoughts into text.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Doctors are using it to help paralyzed patients communicate again.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The biggest takeaway? Your thoughts might not be private anymore.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you ever wondered if your mind is safe online?

caption_text: This AI can read your mind and it's terrifying
